name: Hebei Broadcasting Wireless Media Co., Ltd.
summary: Hebei Broadcasting Wireless Media Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides IPTV integrated broadcast control services in China. The company offers audiovisual programs, including live broadcasts, on-demand content, and replays from CCTV, provincial satellite channels, and local terrestrial channels; value-added services, such as personalized audiovisual programs comprising movies, variety shows, music, games, animation, and special features; and shopping channel transmission services. It also engages in software development; technical services; investment activities; and information consulting. The company was founded in 2009 and is based in Shijiazhuang, China.
